result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-SUD-008

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SUD-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a configuration change coinciding precisely with the onset of KPI degradation across S-SUD-008 and peer sites, supported by topology, alarms, and external events checks ruling out alternatives.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 02:15 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 02:27
- **Affected:** S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, S-SUD-006, S-SUD-008

## Summary

A configuration push CHG-2026-0025 on aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 pushed RAN parameter template OPT-17 affecting admission control and RRC timers, causing simultaneous call setup failures and dropped sessions across multiple connected sites.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose across S-SUD-008 and sibling sites S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006 starting around 2026-09-11 02:15 and continuing past 2026-09-11 06:00.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 02:15: Earliest KPI onset detected: rrc_success_pct drops below baseline on S-SUD-008, S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006. [T3, T9, ANM-000140, ALR-0017]
- 2026-09-11 02:27: Configuration push CHG-2026-0025 executed on aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 (pushing RAN parameter template OPT-17 affecting admission control and RRC timers). [T5, T6, CHG-2026-0025]
- 2026-09-11 02:30: Drop rate KPI deviation onset across S-SUD-008 and sibling sites. [T3, T9, ANM-000145]
- 2026-09-11 03:07: Minor alarm RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH raised on S-SUD-008. [T4, ALM-000193]

## Evidence

- Detector alert ALR-0017 shows ongoing anomaly across S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, S-SUD-006, and S-SUD-008 starting 2026-09-11 02:15. [T1, ALR-0017]
- Topology shows S-SUD-008 connects via LNK-SUD-01-B to aggregation router AGG-SUD-01. [T2, S-SUD-008]
- KPI query shows rrc_success_pct below baseline and drop_rate_pct above baseline for S-SUD-008 starting 2026-09-11 02:15. [T3]
- Configuration change CHG-2026-0025 pushed template OPT-17 to AGG-SUD-01 at 2026-09-11 02:27. [T5, T6, CHG-2026-0025]
- No maintenance windows or external events were found during the incident timeframe. [T7, T10]
- Sibling sites S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006 exhibited concurrent RRC success drops and drop rate spikes. [T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SUD-01: confirmed. Configuration change CHG-2026-0025 pushed to AGG-SUD-01 closely aligns with the widespread RRC degradation and drop rate spikes across all connected child sites. [CHG-2026-0025, T3, T9]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-01-B: rejected. No transport failures or link down alarms were found in the relevant scope during the incident window. [T4]
3. **power_failure** at S-SUD-008: rejected. No power failure alarms or events were recorded for the sites. [T4]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000189: Minor VSWR high alarm on S-SUD-005 on 2026-09-10 22:03 cleared quickly and occurred hours before the incident onset.
- ALM-000190: Minor VSWR high alarm on S-SUD-005 on 2026-09-10 22:35 cleared quickly and is unrelated to simultaneous multi-site core/agg configuration issues.
- ALM-000191: Minor VSWR high alarm on S-SUD-005 on 2026-09-10 23:01 cleared quickly and occurred well before the 02:15 KPI degradation.

## Recommended actions

- Review and rollback configuration change CHG-2026-0025 on AGG-SUD-01.
- Monitor RRC success rates and drop rates on S-SUD-008 and sibling sites after rollback.

KPI query shows rrc_success_pct below baseline and drop_rate_pct above baseline for S-SUD-008 starting 2026-09-11 02:15.
Configuration change CHG-2026-0025 pushed template OPT-17 to AGG-SUD-01 at 2026-09-11 02:27.
No maintenance windows or external events were found during the incident timeframe.
Sibling sites S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006 exhibited concurrent RRC success drops and drop rate spikes.

hypotheses.reason: Configuration change CHG-2026-0025 pushed to AGG-SUD-01 closely aligns with the widespread RRC degradation and drop rate spikes across all connected child sites.
No transport failures or link down alarms were found in the relevant scope during the incident window.
No power failure alarms or events were recorded for the sites.

report.impact_summary: Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose across S-SUD-008 and sibling sites S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006 starting around 2026-09-11 02:15 and continuing past 2026-09-11 06:00.
recommended_actions: Review and rollback configuration change CHG-2026-0025 on AGG-SUD-01.
Monitor RRC success rates and drop rates on S-SUD-008 and sibling sites after rollback.
report.root_cause_summary: A configuration push CHG-2026-0025 on aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 pushed RAN parameter template OPT-17 affecting admission control and RRC timers, causing simultaneous call setup failures and dropped sessions across multiple connected sites.

timeline.event: Earliest KPI onset detected: rrc_success_pct drops below baseline on S-SUD-008, S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006.
Configuration push CHG-2026-0025 executed on aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 (pushing RAN parameter template OPT-17 affecting admission control and RRC timers).
Drop rate KPI deviation onset across S-SUD-008 and sibling sites.
Minor alarm RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH raised on S-SUD-008.

report.title: Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-SUD-008

scope.symptom: Call setup failures and dropped sessions

truth.notes: Change OPT-17 pushed to the aggregation router (AGG-SUD-01) regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back.
